capabilities: Scan a vault folder for audio files (.mp3, .m4a, .wav, .flac, .aac)
Play audio in Obsidian with play, pause, seek, volume, and speed controls
Manage a searchable, sortable playlist with sequential, loop, and shuffle modes
Resume from the last saved position and mark tracks as completed
Open same-name Markdown notes for audio files
extras: Not yet listed in the official Community Plugins directory; must be installed manually from GitHub releases.
problem: Obsidian has no dedicated player for audio files, so users who keep podcasts or generated audio in their vault must open each file individually.
summary: Podcast-style audio player that scans a vault folder for local audio files and plays them with playlist controls, resume, and completion tracking.
